title: You're Overthinking It. Here’s the Simple Way to Start (ft. Nick Huber)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The interview promotes Nick Huber's book, The Sweaty Startup, and directs viewers to a free business-ideas PDF on sweatystartup.com.

idea.name: Bolt Storage
idea.one_liner: Own and manage self-storage properties, leasing units to people who need storage.

key_quotes.quote: It's a business that if you manage these properties well, if you lease units well, if you do good marketing, if you have the right people in there, time takes care of a lot, man.
I pay $500 for a customer in the self- storage business at some of my highest rent locations, you know, blended across my portfolio well under $200.

claims.claim: The host says Nick owns about $100 million of self-storage real estate alongside investors.
claims.quote: Not to mention, he owns about a hund00 million dollars of self- storage real estate alongside investors.

claims.claim: Nick had bought his first 10 self-storage facilities.
claims.quote: nobody cared to know Nick Huber or who I was until I had bought those first 10 self- storage facilities

claims.claim: Customer acquisition cost is $500 at some high-rent locations and well under $200 blended across the portfolio.
claims.quote: I pay $500 for a customer in the self- storage business at some of my highest rent locations, you know, blended across my portfolio well under $200.

claims.claim: Some climate-controlled storage units rent for $300 per month.
claims.quote: where I'm charging, you know, 300 bucks a month for a climate controlled, you know, high high rent storage unit.

claims.claim: At some locations, it costs $500 to fill a unit.
claims.quote: I'm paying 500 bucks to fill that unit.

claims.claim: Nick's company put two facilities, representing almost $10 million in storage, under contract.
claims.quote: We got two self- storage facilities under contract, almost $10 million in storage.

claims.claim: If the two deals had gone ahead, the company would have taken on $10 million in debt and needed $5–6 million for a refinance.
claims.quote: they could have taken down our entire organization because 10 million of debt, you got to have five, $6 million to come up with a refi.

ideas.delivery: The company owns and manages storage properties, leases units, and handles marketing and staffing.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to renter records; rental terms and consumer-facing advertising should comply with UK consumer protection rules.
